examined.reason: Promoted the existing exact three-write state to public rowSelected and replaced the existential RowResult interface by an execution equation. Removed RowResult. Moved the launch-size hypothesis into rowSelected_row, which retains the previous mathematical nonwrapping fact. All frame facts follow from the same unchanged writes; execution is valid even for non-fitting launch sizes. Generic standalone/enclosing-program checks and an oversized-launch wrapping/frame fixture cover the new split.

Composes explicit basesLoaded, rowSelected and addressesComputed states with run_add, then the invariant-based dot loop and exact reluStored suffix through the compact BodyResult. Address pointers use direct expressions and the original wideProduct/row interpretation; all memory/active fields are inherited. BodyResult/body_correct, KernelEntry/KernelResult/kernel_correct statement, numerical definitions and public Sequential theorem remain unchanged. Raw size improves modestly; clearer statements and removal of duplicate result structures are the primary benefit.

The actual PTX source, all instruction generators, launch, parameter conversions, tensor memory hypotheses and the conditional per-thread numerical Sequential guarantee are unchanged. All four straight-line blocks now use exact exit-state equations; the loop retains its invariant and the suffix separately states the semantic result and output frame. No concurrency, CUDA-memory or hardware claim is added.

Removed AddressWords and exposed addressesComputed, specifying both modular offsets and three pointers with PC advance and inherited fields. addressCalculation_exec now proves exact execution equals that state under unchanged active/CodeAt hypotheses. Kernel composition interprets its explicit pointer expressions using the original fitting-row/stride facts. All actual wraparound, near-boundary, alias, wide multiply and arbitrary-placement cases remain; the generic check is restated as an exact state equation.

Replaced BaseResult and the private eight-write final state by public basesLoaded, depending only on converted buffers and initial state. The effect directly sets four 64-bit targets and advances PC by the actual block length; all other fields are inherited. baseLoading_correct states exact successful execution under unchanged parameter/conversion/active/placement hypotheses. Removed the now-unused Argument.register mapping. Existing converter failure, nonidentity conversion, aliasing, frame and arbitrary-prefix execution probes remain; two theorem examples now assert the exact state.

Read the linked block source and consolidated check passage. They are byte-identical to baseline c7c5371; the checker file changes only in its row section. Existing modular pointers, word inputs, block execution, memory and register facts remain unchanged.

Removed SuffixResult and exposed reluStored, specifying bias/add/max/store/PC/return exactly. Execution is an equality under unchanged SuffixEntry/CodeAt. Named reluStored_result and reluStored_output lemmas retain the row-result, selected store and every-other-address frame guarantees. Body composition consumes the equation and these semantic lemmas. Existing exceptional-word, scratch, memory, uninitialized output, arbitrary offset, missing-bias and post-return cases remain; added separate result/output lemma audits and examples.

results.environment: Lean 4.35.0-rc4; pinned dependencies with existing compatibility patches and warnings; committed baseline c7c5371; selected abstract per-thread word-memory model
results.evidence: Full main bridge build and all three kernel/numerical/Sequential groups exit zero. All four straight-line blocks now have public exact effect functions and execution equations: basesLoaded, rowSelected, addressesComputed and reluStored. BaseResult/RowResult/AddressWords/SuffixResult removed; the dot loop retains its invariant. rowSelected_row retains the original fitting-launch row fact; reluStored_result and reluStored_output retain the ordered result, selected store and every-other-address frame. BodyResult/body_correct and KernelEntry/KernelResult/kernel_correct statements are unchanged, as are SuffixEntry, numerical definitions, headline theorem, all instruction generators and PTX source. Actual missing-input/conversion, alias, wraparound, frame, arbitrary-placement, full-width, source/header and numerical probes pass; generic block theorem examples now use exact state equations and new semantic suffix lemmas are separately audited/exercised. Main axiom audit matches c7c5371. Lean-parser tally: library 1554 physical lines, 1112 excluding proof bodies; checks 984/886; total Lean 2538/1998. Comments and blank lines included, dependencies excluded, theorem statements/computational definitions retained. Library decreases 53 total/35 non-proof lines against c7c5371. Stratic exact links/summaries and whitespace validate; snapshots match.
